csharp_indent_braces #

Indent the braces of a block themselves. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-30 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6: it governs a brace that is on a LINE OF ITS OWN, and the oracle is flat at both values under the export's csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = none. With the braces split (= all) the answer is Whitesmiths — the brace takes one level and the body takes the SAME level: class C / { / void M() / { / if (true). Skala applied it whatever the brace placement, so under none the joined opening brace could not move and the closing one did, producing a shape no configuration of either key writes. SK-DIV-0091.

csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks #

Keep a block that was written on one line on one line. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified implementable — the oracle honours it and Skala does not. ⚠ The unprefixed-spelling claim is refuted here too: the C# formatter reads this key. Two distinct oracle outputs under CSReformatCode at true against false on single-line method, if, while and accessor bodies; Skala is flat and already disagrees with the oracle on that fixture before the key is touched. An oracle glob would report INERT, so none is added until the baseline is closed.
